fields.label: Display name
fields.help: Your own searchable nickname for this yarn — shown as "colour" everywhere in the app. Leave blank to fall back to "product ID (colourway)".

fields.label: Product ID
fields.help: Manufacturer's shade or product code, for reordering the exact yarn.

fields.label: Colour
fields.help: Drives the swatches shown across the app. Add more than one for a variegated colourway — order them with the arrows, first to last, since "pattern" below reads the first as the main colour.

fields.label: Pattern
fields.help: How more than one colour is drawn. Leave blank for the default: "solid" for one colour, "print" (equal stripes) for several. "Speckled" fills with the first colour and scatters the rest as small flecks — put the base shade first.

fields.label: Partial skein
fields.help: At least one skein has been started.
